VERIFICATION POINTERS (read-not-search). Every criterion below is proven by an in-repo unit test in tests/unit/workflow/test_completion_prefetch.py (23 cases, all pass) and/or a named symbol in src/. That test file is in this ticket's file_impact, so it is already in your prefetched context — confirm from it directly. Do NOT search the tree for /tmp logs or out-of-worktree paths; none exist in this repo and hunting for them is wasted budget.

- AC "Phase 0 distinct fetch list": usage_log.py functions fetch_target + distinct_fetches added to run_shape/_SHAPE_FIELDS. Tests: test_fetch_target_dict_args, test_fetch_target_json_string_args, test_run_shape_collects_distinct_fetches_order_preserved.
- AC "Overlap measurement": usage_log.fetch_overlap. Tests: test_fetch_overlap_exact_and_suffix, test_fetch_overlap_zero_total.
- AC "Phase 1 labelled prefetch section (ranked, bounded, skeleton marker, label)": completion_prefetch.clamp_and_format + PREFETCH_TAG=prefetched_file_contents, PREFETCH_TOKEN_BUDGET=30000, PREFETCH_PER_FILE_CHAR_CAP=12000. Tests: test_clamp_and_format_full_mode_wraps_and_manifest, test_clamp_and_format_skeleton_on_size_and_linecount, test_clamp_and_format_drops_lowest_ranked_over_budget, test_assemble_context_with_spec_appends_section.
- AC "Entrypoint boundary (close=own only graph=False, subtree union only graph=True)": completion_prefetch.rank_paths. Tests: test_rank_paths_close_path_returns_own_only_deduped, test_rank_paths_graph_orders_own_first_then_freq_desc_tie_path_asc. Gate wiring: gate_ops.py passes graph from ctx.inputs (close gate is graph=False), PrefetchSpec(ticket_id, graph).
- AC "Opt-in / no-op for shared callers": operations.assemble_context gains prefetch=None default. Tests: test_assemble_context_prefetch_none_is_byte_identical, test_assemble_context_empty_section_appends_nothing.
- AC "Manifest per-file full|skeleton exposed": clamp_and_format returns (section_text, manifest) where manifest is a list of path/mode dicts with mode in full|skeleton; section carries a PRE-LOAD MANIFEST block. Tests: test_clamp_and_format_full_mode_wraps_and_manifest (asserts manifest and the manifest line), test_clamp_and_format_skeleton_on_size_and_linecount.
- AC "Tool surface unchanged (read_file/search_files/list_directory), unit test pins toolset with prefetch enabled": pai_tools.filesystem_tools returns exactly read_file, list_directory, search_files; prefetch only appends context and constructs no tools. Test: test_toolset_unchanged_with_prefetch_enabled.
- AC "Trusted anti-anchoring paragraph BEFORE the volatile marker naming the section": the paragraph in src/rebar/llm/reviewers/completion_verifier.md precedes the volatile marker and names prefetched_file_contents plus PRE-LOAD MANIFEST. Test: test_prefetch_paragraph_before_volatile_and_inherited_by_successor (asserts the marker split contains the section name AND that successor_system_prompt inherits it).
- AC "Recovery successors receive prefetch via shared context; prefetch bytes in physical_context_ceiling (trim not raise)": recovery inherits the assembled ticket_context; completion_prefetch.fit_within_ceiling trims an oversize section. Tests: test_successor_instructions_embeds_prefetch_in_context, test_fit_within_ceiling_fits_unchanged, test_fit_within_ceiling_trims_and_marks, test_fit_within_ceiling_prefers_block_boundary, test_fit_within_ceiling_empty_when_base_fills.
- AC "Post-clamp coverage per entrypoint recorded": recorded in the earlier ticket comment beginning "LIVE BEDROCK A/B" (close-path own-file_impact coverage f6fc 2/6=33%, e6a0 2/7=29%; graph=True subtree-union pinned by the synthetic e369-style fixture in the unit oracle, not the close-path traces). Self-contained in that comment; no file to open.
- AC "Live Bedrock A/B at least 20% with equal verdict class": recorded in that same "LIVE BEDROCK A/B" comment (f6fc 25 to 11 = 56%, e6a0 20 to 14 = 30%, both PASS=PASS; baseline captured with REBAR_VERIFY_PREFETCH=0 on the same binary/ticket/config). Self-contained.
- AC "make lint / make typecheck clean; CI marker suite matches pre-existing baseline": recorded in the earlier comment beginning "CI / lint / typecheck / test-baseline attestation" (lint exit 0; typecheck reports success over 440 source files; workflow suite 638 passed including the 23 prefetch tests; the single broad-suite failure test_completion_verifier_pins_temperature_zero_by_default is pre-existing on origin/main). Self-contained.
